notes.title: Fixing achievements and lags!
notes.content:
Hello! As promised, we've finally fixed two long-reported bugs:
Now achievements will appear in the places where they should, and not drop out in a group at the beginning of the next scene.
We have fixed the disappearance of characters, so there will be less lags on weak computers.

Thanks to our friendly programmer for this!
Have a nice day! Team 69Gate.

notes.title: Something very strange happened.
notes.content:
Something very strange happened.
Hello everyone. In Steam, the last week has been a parade of amazing things. For example, for some reason, the price of our game decreased 4 times, and this lasted the whole week. notes.title: DevBlog - Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! A whole month has passed since our last post. During this time, a rather big event took place, which we want to inform you about.

Game development has stopped. Finally and irrevocably. And there is nothing we can do about it. Cyberpunk has taken over our minds, and we are forced to follow the orders of our cybernetic master. All hail to the Cyberpunk!

But seriously, we have some good news.

First, the Chinese translation will be ready this week. We are grateful to everyone who contacted us and offered their help. It was very sweet. Thank you folks!

Also in the patch we will remove some typos in English and Russian. Many thanks to everyone who sent us the typos they found! All typos must die!
You can still email us about any bugs you find at: jean69gate@yahoo.com

Secondly, we found out why the game lags on devices whose system requirements are lower than stated. We'll try to fix it, but don't expect quick fixes. We're not that good programmers. :(

We also know about the problem of incorrect appearance of achievements. For now, this bug will remain in the game. We can easily fix this bug, but then there will be lags with every achievement, so, at this point, the choice is clear for us. 
But this does not mean that we have given up with that bug!

A little about our future plans, except for bug fixes and a new translation:

We have already figured out and decided what we want to do in the sequel. For now, we are working on the skeleton of the main script. There will definitely be more choice, several routes and endings in the next game. We cannot yet say the exact amount, we ourselves do not know.

After we end up with the script, we’re planning to make a small free DLC for this game, which will tell the story from Yukari's point of view, to link the first game and the sequel.

We are also working on changing the animations. The characters should become even more alive and realistic. We'll definitely post animation examples when they're ready.

We'll be sure to keep you updated (if Cyberpunk allows us). 
Thank you for your patience.
69 Gate team.

Happy holiday to all!
That's all for now! Have a good winter!

notes.title: 早上好，亲爱的中国玩家。
notes.content:
早上好，亲爱的中国玩家。
我的名字叫Jean，是一名画师。
《天风之光》和《Touhou Gensokyo Visitor》的立绘都是由我负责绘制的。
但是这两款游戏的制作组却不同。
我确实参与了《天风之光》的制作，但是制作组在中途把我给踢了出去（因为他们不喜欢我画的画），在我离开了之后，这个制作组发生了什么、游戏变成了什么样，我根本无从知晓。
我甚至不知道他们把我画的角色立绘直接用在了游戏里。
我希望大家不要把这两款游戏联系在一起。
《Touhou Gensokyo Visitor》是由一个3人团队开发制作的，在开发过程中也得到了其他几个人的帮助。
我们团队中没有程序员，所以我们在安装Steam成就的时候遇到了困难，迟迟无法继续。
而就在这个时候我想起了Kirill Korzhnew，他是我认识的人中唯一一个程序员。我是在参与《天风之光》制作时认识他的。
顺便一说，他也是跟我在同一时间被《天风之光》制作组踢出去的成员。

我们希望各位玩家可以用开放的心态来为我们的游戏评分，我们会尽力让您满意。
如果您还是对我们有疑问，请通过邮箱联系我吧：jean69gate@yahoo.com
我们会回复每一封邮件的！
我们很乐意与各位玩家交流！

-Jean

notes.title: In release this week!
notes.content:
Hello, folks. We are happy to inform you that the five month development hell is over and the Touhou Gensokyo Visitor is releasing on 10/30/2020.

While we were developing the game, on some sites and in the comments we read quite funny opinions of people who unnecessarily embellish our game. And although we are flattered by this opinion, we must admit that we are not gods. We do not want to disappoint you and believe that the truth is better than false marketing, so we want to tell you a little about our game.

No, this is not a date sim. Initially, we planned to make a date sim, but something went wrong. We wanted to make a game where you can meet different characters, go on dates and get involved in Gensokyo's life. This was in the beginning.

Then we wanted animated characters. Then we had a not very beautiful Reimu, and she needed to be redrawn. Then we realized that 5 roots is not enough, and increased their number to 16. Then we wanted colorful battles, but we don't have much experience working in Python, so we changed the engine, and then again ...

Finally, we’ve decided that a small but well-built game was better than 10 years waiting. In short, our perfectionism has collided with reality. And the reality won.

Touhou Gensokyo Visitor is a kinetic visual novel that tells a short, complete story. The protagonist enters Gensokyo and experiences various adventures there. Unfortunately, we cannot tell you the details to keep you interested in playing.

Today or tomorrow we will post a Demo, so that you can form your opinion.

We hope you enjoy the result of our work. We are ready to accept any criticism from you that will help us improve this and all future games. We are also ready to answer your questions in the comments to this post.

P.S. No, we didn't stop the development of the date sim, we just postponed it a bit. :)

Best Regards,
Jean
